name: How does GEO differ from general SEO for medical practices?
description: GEO targets local searches and map listings for medical practices, while general SEO focuses on broader, non-location-specific search visibility.

mainEntity.name: How does GEO differ from general SEO for medical practices?

acceptedAnswer.text: While general SEO aims to improve overall website visibility across a broad spectrum of search queries, GEO (Local SEO) specifically targets improving visibility for searches that have a local intent. For medical practices, this means focusing on terms like 'cardiologist near me' or 'pediatrician Phoenix.' GEO optimizes for local map packs, local directory listings, and location-specific keywords, whereas general SEO might focus on broader informational content and national rankings.
acceptedAnswer.description: GEO targets local searches and map listings for medical practices, while general SEO focuses on broader, non-location-specific search visibility.
